scope: Public field/code audit only. No private row content was read, no local data analysis was run, and no job was submitted.

status_vocabulary.direct_reuse: Frozen field is suitable for the stated bounded use without semantic relabeling.
status_vocabulary.candidate_existing: Existing candidate evidence can support conservative descriptive/audit statistics, but is not semantic gold and non-detection is not absence.
status_vocabulary.targeted_delta_required: The research construct is absent or materially incomplete in the old release; only a keyed additive field/context pass is justified.

accepted_base.old_release: 2464-shard typed ad_status/experience/technology/v6_audit plus semantic_narrow and duration sidecars
accepted_base.new_bounded_release: D63/D64 rulefirst first-five shards, 424226 canonical postings, metadata joined and comparison outputs QA-passed

comparisons.question: Compare experience-object composition and duration/strength/scope patterns across fixed technology groups while preserving old and new measurement versions.

field_map.use: Exact-key left join only; require uniqueness and exact set/denominator accounting before comparison.

Reuse old clause candidates and durations for old-version descriptive rates. Map general_work to general_work, specific_tool to tool, and industry_domain to industry_domain. Keep object_unspecified unresolved. Do not pool old and rulefirst rows as one taxonomy.

field_map.construct: old ad-level experience flags and duration sidecar
field_map.use: Reuse already projected old-version flags and clause-duration sidecar; preserve main/broad definitions and do not collapse multiple clause bounds into an ad-level minimum.

Old values are structurally NA/unavailable and must never be converted to zero or inferred from general_work/object_unspecified. Rulefirst candidates may be joined as a separate measurement version; a corpus claim requires a keyed additive old-base delta or an explicitly bounded first-five result.

Reuse old frozen technology candidates and old published comparisons within their taxonomy. For rulefirst comparisons derive groups only from non-negated new evidence. Report versions separately because role and taxonomy semantics differ.

old_fields: existing old C1 fixed denominators/weights and retained cells
field_map.use: Keep the already published old T5 estimates and denominators unchanged. For the new D66 overlap estimand, start from all 424226 first-five postings, report old-match and engineering-usable coverage, then compare old/current outcomes on one explicitly shared valid-key population with the same fixed current-rule arms, occupation threshold and min(left_cell_n,right_cell_n) weights. Do not substitute this overlap estimand for old T5 or mix old T5 weights into it.

comparisons.question: Describe co-occurrence of explicit newcomer/waiver wording with current-duty responsibility wording, without treating wording as verified entry-level status.

field_map.use: Old v6_audit supports explicit and applicant-context candidate counts plus retained uncertainty flags. The old IS_UNCONDITIONAL_EXPERIENCE_REQUIREMENT field is structurally set false for explicit-no-experience candidates by the frozen parser, so it is unavailable for an old unconditional-no-experience partition and its zero is not an observed zero. New unrestricted eligibility requires objects_json exactly [general_work]; specific-tool or other waivers stay separate. Never interpret absence of a sparse audit row as no waiver.

field_map.construct: broad qualification alternative candidate and equivalent-experience branch
field_map.use: There is no single old DEGREE_OR gold field. Define a broad qualification-alternative candidate from affirmative credential/training/education alternative fields, and report the EQUIVALENT_EXPERIENCE branch separately. Keep unresolved/multiline branches separate and do not convert education equivalence into general tenure.
Old mixed and unresolved flags exist and can define exclusion/sensitivity strata. They are not semantic gold and must not be folded into unconditional eligibility.

Old sparse v6_audit does not provide a complete graduate/junior cue inventory. Use the new first-five fields only as a separate candidate version; any old-base comparison needs a narrowly keyed additive derivation.

This is the principal true gap in the old release. The new fields are candidate wording only and distinguish duties from prior experience. A corpus result requires a keyed additive responsibility pass or must remain bounded to the first-five release.

new_fields: entry marker x responsibility marker 2x2 counts
field_map.use: The first-five table is already computable as ad-level wording co-occurrence. Keep its 424225 processed denominator and its explicit claim boundary; do not backfill old missing responsibility flags with false or combine old/new cue definitions in one unlabeled series.

conservative_existing_statistics: Old no-experience: count distinct canonical keys with an affirmative NO_EXPERIENCE_EXPLICIT audit row; optionally partition by applicant-context and negated-or-optional fields. Do not report an old unconditional partition: the frozen parser structurally set IS_UNCONDITIONAL_EXPERIENCE_REQUIREMENT=false for explicit-no-experience candidates. On the full processable-ad denominator, no retained row is candidate_not_detected rather than true absence; report audit-row coverage separately.

Old broad qualification-alternative candidate: count distinct keys in an explicitly labeled broad union of EQUIVALENT_CREDENTIAL, ALTERNATIVE_TRAINING_OR_EXPERIENCE, or ALTERNATIVE_TRAINING_OR_EDUCATION. Report EQUIVALENT_EXPERIENCE as its own branch; report QUALIFICATION_RELATION_UNRESOLVED and MIXED_REQUIREMENT_SCOPE separately and allow overlap. On the full processable-ad denominator, no retained row is candidate_not_detected rather than true absence.
Old experience composition: reuse semantic_narrow main/required/preferred/broad flags and the duration sidecar for measured objects only; occupation_task remains NA.
New experience composition: report broad and narrow rulefirst candidates separately, with conditional/unresolved and numeric-duration indicators. No-observed stays unknown.
New entry-responsibility: preserve the existing 2x2 wording-cooccurrence construction and 424225 processed denominator; report every entry and responsibility marker version explicitly.
true_gaps_after_reuse: Old occupation_task prior-experience object: structurally unmeasured.
Old complete current-duty responsibility inventory, including newcomer-role binding: absent/incomplete.
Old complete graduate/junior newcomer wording: not retained in sparse v6_audit.
Full normalized text is not stored in lean tables; any justified delta must reconstruct bounded context from an existing retained source using frozen normalization and exact keys.
A harmonized semantic gold label set does not exist. Old V6/enrichment and new rulefirst outputs must remain versioned candidate measurements.
do_not_do: Do not rerun raw-to-record matching, the 2464-shard base extraction, semantic_narrow projection, or duration construction.
Do not treat v6_audit candidate rows as semantic gold or treat missing sparse rows as negative labels.
Do not infer occupation_task from general_work or object_unspecified.
Do not merge old and new technology, experience, entry, or responsibility fields without an explicit measurement-version column.
Do not change common-support denominators, thresholds, cell weights, or arm definitions while adding fields.
